_comment: Golden `sanitize` vectors. sanitize in plugins/uns/exec_configure.go owns this rule; a client that validates before submitting keeps a native copy to predict model-slot path collisions before execution. One dataset judged by colca's Go suite (plugins/uns/sanitize_test.go) and by every native copy, so the copies cannot drift apart. sanitize replaces '/', '+', '#', ' ' and any control character (codepoint < 0x20) with '_', trims leading and trailing '_' runs, and falls back to "tag" when nothing is left.
